architecture-review.json.review: No new project references, runtime partial files, provider interfaces or duplicated dispatch loops. Explicit inherited admission is a small Core factory; immutable origin and protocol validation are in Models. The three new findings are two member-count information notices on the original-origin and JSON wire records and one file-size warning on the existing planning owner (361 lines). The owner remains cohesive: shared work transitions and basis attachment handle both explicit origins; the new origin's validation and creation remain outside it. Existing journal-size warnings remain. Five prior type cycles are unchanged; no project cycle. MAF selects instruction strictly by admitted origin. Workbench only rejects inherited input at its interactive boundary. Actual Process/Workflow publication is still gated.
